title: Second-Hand, First Choice

pre.en: Who owned Ella's denim jacket before her?
pre.zh: Ella 那件牛仔夹克以前是谁的？

intro: 这是一段口播式的短报道：先抛出调查数字，再讲一个真人的经历，然后是反对的声音和 App 方面的说法，最后落在一个小故事上。读的时候留意 as … as 的各种用法：twice as likely as、just as good as、not nearly as expensive、not as likely … as——说「一样」「不如」「是…的几倍」。

sentences.en: Here's a number that might surprise you.
sentences.zh: 先说一个可能会让你吃惊的数字。

sentences.en: Almost half of UK shoppers aged 18 to 24 bought clothes on a second-hand app last year.
sentences.zh: 去年，英国 18 到 24 岁的购物者里，将近一半在二手 App 上买过衣服。

sentences.en: That's according to a new survey of 2,000 people.
sentences.zh: 这是一项针对 2000 人的新调查得出的结果。

sentences.en: In 2020, the figure was only one in five.
sentences.zh: 2020 年，这个数字还只有五分之一。

sentences.en: And young people are now twice as likely as their parents to buy second-hand.
sentences.zh: 而且现在年轻人买二手的可能性，是他们父母的两倍。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么呢？

sentences.en: Well, many say second-hand clothes are just as good as new, and not nearly as expensive.
sentences.zh: 很多人说，二手衣服跟新的一样好，价钱却便宜得多。

sentences.en: Others sell things on to make room for new ones, and earn a bit of money.
sentences.zh: 也有人把旧衣服转手卖掉，给新衣服腾地方，顺便赚点小钱。

sentences.en: And a few have even taken up mending as a hobby.
sentences.zh: 还有少数人干脆把缝缝补补当成了爱好。

sentences.en: Take Ella Brooks, a 22-year-old nurse from Manchester.
sentences.zh: 就拿 Ella Brooks 来说，她 22 岁，是曼彻斯特的一名护士。

sentences.en: Last spring, she decided to sort out her wardrobe once and for all.
sentences.zh: 去年春天，她下定决心要把衣柜彻底收拾一遍。

sentences.en: She sold eleven things she never wore and made £140.
sentences.zh: 她把十一件从来不穿的衣服卖了，赚了 140 英镑。

sentences.en: Then, by chance, she spotted a wool coat for £8 while she was looking for boots.
sentences.zh: 后来她找靴子的时候，碰巧看到一件羊毛大衣，只要 8 英镑。

sentences.en: "I snapped it up for next to nothing," she told us.
sentences.zh: 「我几乎没花钱就抢到手了，」她跟我们说。

sentences.en: "A coat like that would cost a fortune new, and it probably wouldn't be as warm."
sentences.zh: 「这样的大衣买新的得花一大笔钱，还不一定有这么暖和。」

sentences.en: Ella worked out that her whole winter outfit cost less than one new pair of jeans.
sentences.zh: Ella 算了算，她一整套冬装加起来，比一条新牛仔裤还便宜。

sentences.en: Since then, she's cut down on new clothes.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，她新衣服买得少多了。

sentences.en: Of course, not everyone's happy.
sentences.zh: 当然，也不是人人都高兴。

sentences.en: Some small shop owners say they can't compete with prices that low.
sentences.zh: 一些小服装店的店主说，价格这么低，他们根本没法竞争。

sentences.en: But a spokesperson for one app, Second Look, says the change is good for everyone.
sentences.zh: 可二手 App「Second Look」的一位发言人说，这个变化对大家都有好处。

sentences.en: "Most cheap new clothes are high in plastic, and they don't last as long as wool or cotton," she said.
sentences.zh: 「便宜的新衣服大多塑料成分很高，没有羊毛、棉的经穿，」她说。

sentences.en: "And older styles aren't as likely to go out of fashion as people think."
sentences.zh: 「而且老款式并不像大家想的那么容易过时。」

sentences.en: On the app, sellers are allowed to set their own prices.
sentences.zh: 在这个 App 上，卖家可以自己定价。

sentences.en: The most popular items are jeans and jackets.
sentences.zh: 最受欢迎的是牛仔裤和夹克。

sentences.en: Actually, Ella's favourite find so far is a denim jacket for £6.
sentences.zh: 说起来，Ella 到目前为止最得意的收获，是一件 6 英镑的牛仔夹克。

sentences.en: It turned out her mum had sold it on the same app a year earlier.
sentences.zh: 后来才知道，那件夹克是她妈妈一年前在同一个 App 上卖掉的。

sentences.en: And now her mum's asked if she can borrow it.
sentences.zh: 现在她妈妈反倒问她能不能借去穿。

cards.note: as shown by a report, a study or what someone has said
做调查是 carry out a survey。
也有「身材、人物」的意思，这里是「数字」。
to sell something that you bought earlier to another person
cards.tip: on 表示「往下传」；和 sell sth on an app（在 App 上卖）的 on 不是一回事。
cards.example: He buys old bikes, fixes them and sells them on.

cards.note: to move or remove things so that there is space for something else
cards.tip: room 在这里是不可数名词「空间」，不加 a；也可以说 make room for sb（给某人让个位子）。
cards.example: We sold the old sofa to make room for a desk.

cards.note: to start doing a new activity, especially for fun
cards.tip: as a hobby 说明是当爱好；不要和 take up space（占地方）混了。
cards.example: My dad took up golf when he retired.

cards.note: 动词 mend：mend a hole in a jumper。
completely and finally, so that something does not happen or need doing again
in a way that was not planned
形容词 woollen（英式两个 l）。
to buy something quickly because it is cheap or there are not many left
cards.tip: 常用被动：be snapped up（被抢光）；代词放中间：snap it up。
cards.example: The cheap tickets were snapped up in an hour.

cards.note: for a very small amount of money
cards.tip: next to 在这里是「几乎」：next to nothing = almost nothing。
cards.example: We bought the table at a car-boot sale for next to nothing.

cards.note: to be very expensive
cards.tip: cost 的过去式和过去分词都是 cost；口语夸张说法，类似的还有 cost an arm and a leg。
cards.example: Fixing the roof cost a fortune.

cards.note: to do exercise to make your body stronger and fitter
cards.tip: 第 55 课的 work out 是「健身」；这里是「算出来」，后面常接 that 从句或 how much。
cards.example: Can you work out how much we each owe?

cards.note: 指搭配好的一整套穿着。
to do, use or eat less of something
和谁竞争用 with；名词是 competition。
代表哪个机构用 for。
to contain a lot of something, such as sugar, fat or salt
cards.tip: 反义是 be low in sth；多用来说食物，这里借来说衣服的面料。
cards.example: These cereals are high in sugar.

cards.note: to stop being popular or fashionable
cards.tip: 反义是 come into fashion；「正流行」是 be in fashion。
cards.example: White trainers never seem to go out of fashion.

cards.note: to have permission to do something
a denim jacket 就是牛仔夹克。
